opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. No deadline; applications accepted whenever ready. Projects must take into account the four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability).

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10million (exceptional projects over £10m may be considered). Requires Expression of Interest first, then two phases (development up to two years, delivery up to five years). Applications have quarterly deadlines.
